critique: The render has a strong Red Kaleidospace foundation: dense red point-grid surfaces, bright red filament folds, a black field, and clearly evolving geometry between t1 and t4. The silhouette remains overly spherical and is cropped at both the top and bottom, making it feel like an enlarged organic globe rather than a deliberately framed kaleidoscopic structure. The t1-to-t4 changes are active but still read as broad surface reshuffling more than a controlled, continuous kaleidoscopic fold.

suggestions.why: Reduce the vertical base-shape extent so the full red structure fits inside frame, restoring a deliberate silhouette instead of top/bottom cropping.
Slow Evolution so the visible folding reads as continuous organic kaleidoscopic motion rather than large configuration changes across the sampled frames.
